name: Agent OS
description: AgentOS is an operating system for AI agents, built around runtime, observability, security, and evals. It helps teams build agents that are easier to trace, monitor, test, and deploy with more confidence.

name: AIGO AI
description: Aigo is a Cognitive AI platform focused on building adaptive, self-learning AI systems that go beyond traditional large language models. Instead of relying on massive datasets and probabilistic generation, Aigo emphasizes continuous learning, reasoning, memory, and contextual understanding to create intelligent assistants for enterprise applications

name: AIHouse

name: Amazon
description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a leading cloud computing platform that provides on-demand infrastructure, storage, databases, AI services, and developer tools. It enables businesses and developers to build, deploy, and scale applications without managing physical servers.

name: Apify
description: Apify is a cloud platform for web scraping, data extraction, and browser automation that helps developers and businesses collect, process, and analyze web data at scale. It provides ready-made tools (Actors) and infrastructure for automating web tasks, crawling websites, and building data pipelines.

name: AutonomLayer
description: AutonomLayer is an autonomous AI software engineering platform that goes beyond traditional AI coding assistants. Instead of requiring continuous prompting, it independently plans work, generates and refines prompts, writes code, tests, debugs, reviews, and iterates until an application is production-ready.

name: BAND
description: BAND is an enterprise-grade interaction layer that enables humans and AI agents to collaborate seamlessly. It provides real-time communication, built-in governance, and a structured framework for managing complex multi-agent systems securely and at scale.

name: Brain2
description: A second brain to help humans liberate their first one

name: Cognee
description: Cognee is an open-source memory platform for AI agents that transforms documents, relational data, and system context into persistent memory. It helps agents retain context across sessions and integrates seamlessly with tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and n8n.

name: Cresca
description: Cresca is an AI-powered relationship memory tool that helps users capture, organize, and recall important details about the people they meet, making it easier to build and maintain meaningful connections.

name: Daytona
description: Daytona is a secure and scalable infrastructure platform for running AI-generated code and AI agent workflows. name: Finchip AI
description: FinChip helps turn AI skills into ownable digital assets that can be launched, discovered, used, and traded. For builders exploring agent capabilities, skill marketplaces, and programmable AI services, FinChip opens up a new way to think about software as something agents can own and invoke.

name: Frontier Tower
description: Frontier Tower is a 16-floor innovation hub in San Francisco being transformed into a self-governed vertical village for frontier technologies and creative expression. It brings together leading researchers, builders, entrepreneurs, and artists working at the edge of human progress.

It provides an intuitive environment for prompt engineering, model experimentation, and API integration, making it easy to prototype and integrate generative AI into applications.

name: Govia

Through innovative tools and accessible resources, GoVia empowers individuals with information, support, and guidance to promote accountability, de-escalation, and informed decision-making.

name: Growing Pies
description: Growing Pies is supporting builders at Wizard Hackathon with a dedicated winning prize and helping bring more energy, opportunity, and momentum to the builder community.

name: GrowthMasters

It focuses on helping companies improve customer acquisition, optimize growth strategies, and build scalable systems for long-term success.

name: Homebrew Club

It provides flexible workspaces, a vibrant community, and resources that help individuals and teams grow their ideas into successful ventures.

name: HydraDB
description: The serverless context infra built with in-memory data stores: ultra low latency, highest precision recall, and relationally-aware. Build memory layers, stateful agents, and context stores with the highest accuracy.

name: InsForge
description: InsForge is building agent-native cloud infrastructure for modern AI development. It brings together model gateway, compute, deployment, database, authentication, and more so AI coding agents can operate across the full development workflow.

name: Lyzr

name: Opsera
description: Opsera is an AI-powered continuous delivery and DevOps automation platform that helps organizations streamline software delivery, improve engineering productivity, and manage complex DevOps workflows. name: Qdrant
description: Power your app with high-performance vector search—perfect for multi-modal sports data, video retrieval, and biometrics.

name: Render

It provides a simple developer experience with automatic deployments, managed services, and scalable hosting.

name: Replit

name: RocketRide

name: Synk
description: Snyk helps developers build securely by automatically finding and fixing vulnerabilities in code, open-source dependencies, containers, and infrastructure. It's an essential part of modern software development, ensuring that AI-generated code is secure before it reaches production.

name: Tavily

name: TRAE
